notes.title: Version 0.4a
notes.content:
Version 0.4a is finally here and with it comes some improvements and bug fixes.
As always I am on Discord if you would like to chat about the game or want to see the latest reports and give your suggestions and feedback. I normally also hand out tester keys when ever someone wants to try so it's a great option for everyone.

Discord: https://discord.gg/2FXKjDaX

I would like to take this moment to thank the fellowship on discord for their support over these past few months. 

Added:
Addressable support
Heal and Hurt Zones
Gold & Fame Icons
Chat spam protection
Chainmail, Iron, Dark Iron, Knight and leather pants.
Drop bags with various rarities
Frost Knight Minion
Hurt, Heal, Slow, Fast and more Zones


Updated:
Made the loading screen more dynamic.
UI art to reflect new design of game.
Server to run at 60Hz.
Portals to be faster to load.
Chat to show username in color.
Database to handle new design.
Social Icon with new icon.
Chat setting menu with a new design.
Nametags to be more dynamic and scale to how big your name is.
Chat slider to adjust how much text displays on Screen.
Reworked the perma death mechanic



Adjusted:
Increased max population from 200 to 300.

Removed: 
Stats menu

Bug Fixes:
Fixed player speed increase when moving in a diagonal direction.
Fixed player desync when going though portals
Fixed player desync when killing mobs.
Fixed chat desync issue


Notes:
Rebuilt entire project from ground up reducing bugs, improving performance and re-imagining many aspects of the game.

notes.title: Alpha 0.3
notes.content:
This week of development I focused on improving our back end data management and implemented a number of new features like the ability to pick up and use items. 

There was a number of bugs in version 0.2 that has since been fixed and now we are in a stable version of the game. 

Saving Player Data upon leaving and when server shuts down
Health Potions now work
Players can pick up items
Monsters now drop items
Animations are now syncing properly
Fixed weapon desync issue caused by scaling values inverting the direction of the player when moving.
Fixed Attack Direction desync bug and reduced data amount needed for it to sync.
Fixed item pick up authority bug.
Fixed Dropped item icon improperly showing the wrong item.
Fixed Monster movement Desync
Added Player Armor Stats to combat.
Fixed Item spawn bug
Built new world.

If you are reading this and are not apart of our Discord community then come check us out! 
https://discord.gg/WBFt9PY4Xu

I'm normally in the discord talking to fans so if you are interested in MMORPG bullet hells come join us.

notes.title: Alpha 0.2
notes.content:
Fixed chat de-sync issue.
Fixed movements not moving downwards or upward when sliding against a wall.
Fixed spawn sync issue after a player would die.
Fixed name tags being under the walls
Fixed chat movement bug where players would hit WASD and it would show up in chat and where players could still move when typing in chat.
Added exp gain text
Adjusted Skeleton king health.
Added weapon stat sync so different armors and weapons have their own stats instead of it just being based on the same number for an attack.

There is a lot going on with development so check the Discord if you are interested in being apart of the alpha testing. ːsteamthumbsupː
